# temps_error_saved_search (Resource)

A saved search over a project's error groups, owned by the API key's user and optionally shared with the project's members.

Import with `<project_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `error_tracking:read`, `error_tracking:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_error_saved_search" "timeouts" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  name       = "Unresolved timeouts"
  shared     = true
  filters    = jsonencode({ status = "unresolved", search = "timeout" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the search.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `filters` (String) Filters: `jsonencode({ status = "unresolved", environment_id = 3, search = "timeout" })`. A JSON document; use `jsonencode(...)`.
- `shared` (Boolean) Show it to every member of the project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>/<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_error_saved_search.timeouts 8/5
```
